paragraphs: Rabbi Matun said: R. Yehoshua ben Levi said, Bava Kamma 96a. He asked R. Yoḥanan, who told him, 'Matun, Matun,' Jerusalem Talmud, Megalleḥin, halakhah 7. It requires examination, since Matun is a gentile woman's name—see Rav Adda bar Ahavah—and they do not name after her.
